console_warnings: Non-blocking SVG animation warning (repeats on pages containing StackVisual): 'Error: <animate> attribute keyTimes: Invalid value, "0;0.916;0.966;1.046;1."'. Root cause: keyTimes values include a value >1 (1.046) which violates SVG SMIL spec (must be in [0,1] monotonically). Animation still runs in Chromium but the console error is emitted on every render. File: /app/frontend/src/components/StackVisual.jsx.
action_items: Optional: Fix keyTimes attribute in StackVisual.jsx SVG <animate> - clamp values to [0,1] (e.g., replace '1.046' with '1') to silence recurring Chromium console error.
critical_code_review_comments: StackVisual.jsx keyTimes list has 1.046 which is invalid per SVG SMIL spec; browsers accept but emit console error each mount. Trivial fix.
Partner testid 'partner-upbeat tech' contains a space (generated via name.toLowerCase()) - works but is unusual; consider slugifying with hyphen for consistency with 'partner-c-dac'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 review items PASS at 1920x1080 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile). Only observation is a non-blocking SVG keyTimes warning from StackVisual.jsx. Partner testid convention uses raw lowercased name (space preserved for 'upbeat tech').
